planning_notes: No serial I/O requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are requested.
Button D2 is assumed wired with internal pullup; active_high is set to false so the model 'pressed' is true when the pin reads LOW.
D13 is included as a required explicitly-wired output (device_role digital_output) but its business meaning is left to SysML since no exact behavior was specified.
PWM output D9 uses catalog scale=255 and offset=0 to map a model brightness command to the PWM_count domain; exact mapping from light sensor value to brightness level is handled in SysML.
TM1637 numeric display is created on CLK=D4 and DIO=D5 as specified; the actual mapping from light intensity to displayed numeric range and formatting are handled in SysML.
Control period is chosen as 10 ms as a reasonable scheduling granularity; any longer sampling/reporting timing for the light-to-display/brightness update is handled in SysML.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Ambient light sensor (LDR) raw ADC for auto/manual brightness mapping

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: LED brightness command mapped from ambient light (auto mode) or frozen value (manual mode)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Mode toggle button: press to switch auto->manual (freeze), press again to restore auto

interfaces.name: io_3
interfaces.meaning: Status indicator (e.g., mode or heartbeat; SysML decides exact behavior)

interfaces.name: io_4
interfaces.meaning: Display current light-mapped numeric value; auto mode shows mapped LDR value, manual mode shows frozen value

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 设计一个光照联动显示系统，使用光敏电阻 A0、PWM LED D9、TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）和按钮 D2。默认根据光照强度自动调节 LED 亮度并在数码管显示当前光照映射值；按下按钮后切换到手动冻结显示模式，再按一次恢复自动模式。
